name: SessionNav
description:
The Assistant section drawer's content: New chat, search, the two views (conversations,
archived) with counts, projects, and the sessions grouped by day. Each row shows its
title, whose chat it is (the organisation's code, or All: history is never filtered by the
organisation switcher, R6.9), last activity, and what it needs — a spinner while working,
a warning dot when it waits for you (approval), a danger dot after a failed run, an accent
dot when unread. The title truncates first. Rows carry the session actions (R12): the ⋯
menu and right-click read one definition. The drawer decides the width (any width from its
narrowest up); the content never widens it.
signature: ({ sessions, projects, selectedId: selectedIdProp, defaultSelectedId, view, onViewChange, counts, loading, onNewChat, onSelectedIdChange, onRename, onArchive, onRestore, onDelete, onOpenWindow, onSelectProject, onOpenSettings, initialQuery, className, }: SessionNavProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: counts
props.description: Counts grouped by category or status.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The session current at first when the selection is uncontrolled.

props.name: initialQuery
props.description: Start with this search (templates, deep links).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows loading feedback in the space reserved for the content.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Called with the session from its Archive action, offered for sessions that are not archived.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called with the session after the person confirms Delete; unavailable while its response is working. A returned promise keeps the action pending until it settles.

props.name: onNewChat
props.description: Called from New chat; the button is shown only when this is supplied.

props.name: onOpenSettings
props.description: Called from the AI settings row at the foot of the list; the row is shown only when this is supplied.

props.name: onOpenWindow
props.description: Called with the session from its Open in window action; the action is shown only when this is supplied.

props.name: onRename
props.description: Called with the session and its new trimmed title when an inline rename (Rename or F2) is committed with Enter or blur; not called when the title is empty, unchanged or the edit is cancelled with Esc. Supplying it enables renaming.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Called with the session from its Restore action, offered for archived sessions.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: ((id: string | null, details: SelectionChangeDetails<AiSession>) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Called with the id of the session whose row is clicked or activated with Enter, and
details whose `item` is the session; not called for the session already current.

props.name: onSelectProject
props.description: Called with the project whose row is pressed in the Projects group.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with `conversations` or `archived` when the person picks Conversation history or Archived chats. Pair with `view` to switch the list.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The current session's id, or null for none; its row is marked current. Controlled while defined; leave it undefined to use `defaultSelectedId`.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Conversations or sessions shown in the navigation.
